title: QuickPack Job
description: One packing job for the shared Three.js viewer. A new product is a new job folder (this JSON + texture files). Do not fork the engine. All lengths are millimetres. Panel local space: +X across the face, +Y up the upright face, +Z toward the print. A non-root panel hinges only by being crease.panelB of exactly one crease; the crease axis passes through the child origin and axis.direction is in that child's local space.

carton.description: Outer carton. nominalOutsideMm is the outside size FIT compares to the grid. QC-style: length × width × height, crease to crease.

rolls.description: Alternative to inners for roll-packed goods. Same assembly shape. Use inners or rolls (or neither for a dieline draft).

steps.description: Fold-slider chapters. t is 0–100, the same clock crease.foldWindow and pack.dropWindow use.

productCode.description: Job code. The sample uses an EXAMPLE label. Do not invent Product Master numbers.

sources.description: Where the numbers came from. estimate = assumed constant, not a measured dieline or a Product Master row.

pageSizeMm.description: Optional PDF page size in mm, written by the dieline parser stub.

rect.description: Panel rectangle in the panel's own local millimetres. The origin is the hinge (the root panel's origin is the assembly origin). +Y is up the upright face. Negative x or y places material on the other side of the hinge, which is how flaps are drawn before they fold.

role.description: face = wall or lid panel, glue = manufacturer's joint, flap = fold-in flap, window = opening mark (outline in this scaffold; real contours come from a later dieline parse).

printFace.description: Which external texture to show on +Z. hero is the face pack.heroTowardDisplay aims at +Z (the display side).

textureRef.description: Path relative to this job JSON. A file under textures/. Never a data: URL or base64.

crease.description: The only hinge between two panels. panelB's origin sits at attachMm in panelA's local space. Rotation is the right-hand rule about axis.direction, which is expressed in panelB local space and passes through panelB's origin.

direction.description: Axis direction in panelB local space. Does not need to be unit length.

attachMm.description: panelB origin, in panelA local millimetres.

foldDeg.description: Signed fold at the end of foldWindow. 0 keeps the child coplanar (used for a window mark).

lengthMm.description: Dashed crease length drawn along the axis. Defaults to the child panel's longer edge.

thicknessMm.description: Board caliper of this blank. The carton value is what the FIT floor uses; inners may differ.

nominalOutsideMm.description: Outside length × width × height in mm. Required on the carton. FIT cavity is L−2t, W−2t, H−floor.

flatPositionMm.description: Where the blank sits on the table before orientWindow. Y is ignored; the viewer rests the sheet on the floor at the current caliper.

seatMm.description: Where the assembly origin sits once orientWindow has finished, in pack millimetres.

uprightEulerDeg.description: Euler XYZ degrees of the folded blank in use. Cartons and vertical inners use [0,0,0] (root face standing, print toward +Z). A hood whose local XY is the top board uses [-90,0,0] so print faces up.

pack.description: How folded inners or rolls sit inside the carton. Resting Y is fully determined by anchor. center → the packed item's geometric center is at floor + H/2. pivot → the assembly origin is at floor. H is itemHeightMm. floor = carton.thicknessMm × floorBoardLayers (layers of carton board under the goods, usually 2). Example with floor 4 mm and H 120 mm: center rests at 64 mm, pivot rests at 4 mm.

eb.description: Pack orientation. vertical: root panel +Y is up, and that panel's rectMm.h is H. horizontal is reserved for a later job; H is still the vertical extent used by the resting-Y rule.

colMm.description: Cell length along X. For a vertical inner this equals the root panel rectMm.w.

rowMm.description: Cell depth along Z. Row 0 is the row toward +Z (display).

cells.description: Row-major inner or roll ids, length cols×rows. An empty array means the draft has no packed items yet.

anchor.$comment: center → resting Y = floor + H/2 (geometric center). pivot → resting Y = floor (assembly origin). Must match restingYRule.

restingYRule.description: Must pair with anchor. center pairs with floor+H/2. pivot pairs with floor. floor = carton.thicknessMm × floorBoardLayers. H = itemHeightMm.

heroTowardDisplay.description: When true, yaw the packed item about Y so the printFace hero normal points to +Z (the display side). Yaw is about the geometric center, so a square footprint does not change cell.

itemHeightMm.description: H in the resting-Y rule. For eb=vertical this is the inner root panel height.

floorBoardLayers.description: Carton board layers under the goods. floor = carton.thicknessMm × floorBoardLayers. Two layers is the usual double bottom (inner flap + outer flap).

stagger.description: Slider units added to dropWindow start per cell index, so items settle one after another.

dropDuration.description: Slider units each item takes to move from above the carton down to its resting Y.
